facts.text: Under UB's Finish in 4 pledge, students who fulfill all requirements but cannot graduate in four years can complete needed courses free of tuition and comprehensive fees.

sources.title: Finish in 4 - Student Success and Academic Support Gateway - University at Buffalo
sources.quote: If you take the pledge and fulfill all of the requirements but still can't graduate in four years, UB will provide the opportunity to complete the needed courses free of tuition and comprehensive fee charges.
